definitions.explanation: a lump sum payment made to employees when they leave a company, whether due to retirement or resignation

examples.japanese: {退職金|たいしょくきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくら⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How much severance pay will I receive?

examples.japanese: {退職金|たいしょくきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{完済|かんさい}→完済：18945_kansai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I paid off my home loan with my retirement allowance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勤続|きんぞく}{年数|ねんすう}→勤続年数：25628_kinzokunensuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ほど、{退職金|たいしょくきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The longer your years of service, the larger your severance pay.

notes:
{退職金|たいしょくきん} is the lump-sum payment employees receive when leaving a company, a significant part of Japanese employment compensation.

WRITING:
- ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧ (retirement, resignation)
- {金|きん} (money)

JAPANESE EMPLOYMENT CONTEXT:
- Traditional Japanese companies often have substantial {退職金|たいしょくきん} systems
- Amount typically increases with years of service
- Some companies now shifting to defined contribution plans

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {退職金|たいしょくきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧ (to receive severance)
- {退職金|たいしょくきん}{制度|せいど} (severance pay system)
- {退職金|たいしょくきん}⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧ (severance regulations)

- ⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧ (pension)
- ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧ (retirement, leaving a job)
- ⟦{定年|ていねん}{退職|たいしょく}→定年退職：16450_teinentaishoku⟧ (mandatory retirement)
